## August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 175)

This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American and South African radio, three thrilling serial installments of Alex Raymond's *Jungle Jim* starring Matt Crowley and Gerald Mohr (Stacey's Captivity, Temple of the Cobra Queen, and Ivory Smugglers of Zanzibar), James Melton and Jane Froman on the *Texaco Star Theater*, Frank Lovejoy narrating the Arctic convoy to Murmansk on *It's Maritime*, and George Douglas Brown's *The House with the Green Shutters* on *Radio Playhouse* (1939–1975):
